tei:titleStmt.tei:title: ༄༅/ /kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi zhi khro'i las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs dus mtha'i cho ga thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /
༄༅/ /kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi zhi khro'i las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs dus mtha'i cho ga thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ /

tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi zhi khro'i las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs dus mtha'i cho ga thar pa'i lam ston zhes bya ba bzhugs so//

kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus las/ zhi khro gsang ba 'dus pa'i las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs/ gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga thar pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba/ kun bzang zhi khro'i lha la phyag 'tshal lo// de yang dbang thob cing dam tshig sdom pa la gnas pa'i sngags pas/ lnga par thal ba'i lus can rnams kyi nyes ltung sbyangs te go 'phang dam pa gnyis la 'god par byed pa'i lam nyams su blang ba la gsum/ sngon 'gro/ dngos gzhi/ rjes gsum mo// dang po ni/ zhi khro rtsa ba'i dkyil 'khor rdul tshon nam ras bris gang yang rung ba'i dbus su zhi ba'i bum pa dkar po tshad dang ldan pa yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul gyis bdug cing khro bo'i sngags bzlas pas bgegs dang bral par byas pa'i nang du rgyun 'bab kyi chu rta glang sogs kyis ma bsgrod cing srog chags med pas sum gnyis bkang ba lnga tshan lnga'i rdzas dang*/ bum mtshan sna tshogs pad+ma'i lte bar nyi ma la rigs lnga'i sa bon bris par bkod cing*/ dar ras dkar po'i mgul chings dang ldan pa'i steng du/ khro bo'i bum pa thod pa mtshan ldan chang la a mṛ ta btab pas bkang ba'i steng du/ dar dmar po dang me long gis kha bkab/ zhi khro'i pho brang yod na de'i steng du dbub/ phyi skor du mchod pa dang sman raka gtor ma sogs bshams/ slob dpon gyi mdun nam g.yas su/ las bum/ khrus bum bgegs dang bral bar byas pa'i nang du bum rdzas sogs zhi ba'i bum pa ltar bcas pas/ dbang gi tsakli'i ngag 'don dang mtshungs pa tshad sdoms su bris pa dang*/ ḍā ru/ rdor dril/ me long*/ khrus ras/ sbyang chas/ til/ bye ma sogs nyer mkho'i yo byad thams cad tshogs par bkram/ slob dpon dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgo dang sgrub g.yog yod na bde ba'i stan la gang 'os su 'khod par bya'o// gnyis pa dngos gzhi la las gzhung bsrangs shing bdag nyid dkyil 'khor du 'jug pa dang*/ sgrib sbyong gi cho ga dngos so// dang po ni/

zhi khro gsang ba 'dus pa'i las gzhung bgegs la bka' bsgo ba nas tshogs bsngo bya ba'i bar dkyus ltar la/ lha rnams bskyed pa'i tshe bdag mdun tha mi dad du tshig dkyus ltar bskyed cing*/ zhi ba'i bum pa'i nang du zhi ba zhe gnyis dang*/ khro bo'i bum pa'i nang du khrag 'thung nga brgyad kyang skad cig gis gsal ba rdzogs par bskyed la/ bsnyen pa'i rim pa phyin bdag mdun bum gsum lhan gcig tu bya'o// de nas las bum gyi nang du bdud rtsi 'khyil pa dang*/ khrus bum gyi nang du rdo rje sems dpa' bskyed la/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces las bum dang*/ khrus bum la yig brgya ci nus bzla/ bum pa gnyis ma 'dzom na bum pa gcig gi nang du khrus las kyi lha gnyis ka bskyed nas bzlas pa bya/ long med na lha ma bskyed par sngags gnyis po kho na bzlas pas kyang don 'grub bo/ de nas slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug pa ni/ khrus bum gyi chus khrus byas la/ hūm̐ */ rig rtsal lhun grub lha tshogs 'di| |dus gsum sangs rgyas sku gsung thugs// yon tan phrin las zhi khro'i sku// ma skyes lhun gyis grub pa'i lha// bskal pa sngon nas da lta'i bar| /ye nas rang dang gnyis med gcig /ma rig dbang gis zhal ma mjal// da nas rang rig thugs rje'i lha/ /ngo bo rang bzhin thugs rjer ldan| |sku gsung ye shes lnga yi bdag /dbang bskur chen po bdag la stsol// lha dbang lus la zhugs pa yis// lus kyang ye shes lnga ru grol// sangs rgyas sku yi dbang thob shog /sku yi byin rlabs ngag la zhugs// grag stong ā li kā li'i sgra// rang byung chos kyi sgra dbyangs ldan// sangs rgyas gsung gi dbang thob shog /gsung sgra sems la zhugs pa yis// bde gsal mi rtog chos nyid dbyings/ ka dag chen po yangs pa'i klong*/ sangs rgyas thugs kyi dbang thob shog /kā ya sid+dhi oṃ/ wāka sid+dhi āḥ

tsit+ta sid+dhi hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ zhi khro'i bum pa gnyis slob dpon rang gi gnas gsum du bzhag pas/ bum mdun gyi lha rnams las ye shes pa'i tshogs spros te slob dpon rang nyid la thim pas dbang bskur ba'i nus mthu dang ldan par bsam/ bum pa gnyis kyi bcud lce thog tu myang*/ mthar/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas/ slob dpon gyi gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs shing brtan par byas par bsam mo// gnyis pa sgrib sbyong gi cho ga dngos ni/ dkyil 'khor gyi lho sgo pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa bris pa'i dbus su/ ro yod na gos dmar po bskon/ steng na gdugs la sogs pas g.yogs la bzhag /rus bu yod na'ang tshul de ltar bya/ mtshan byang byed na byang bu bris pa'i gnas yig mthong ba brgyud pa ltar dang*/ mtha' skor du/ 'jig rten 'di nas pha rol du tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba/ dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum/ rgyal ba zhi khro'i lha tshogs rnams la phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o// 'khor ba dang ngan song bar do'i 'jigs pa chen po las bskyab tu gsol/ zhes bris pa bkod/ de rnams gang yod kyang mar dkar la tshe 'das kyi gzugs gos rgyan dang ldan pa thal sbyar pus btsugs gus 'dud kyi tshul can bcas pa'i snying khar nṛ'i mthar tshe 'das che ge mo zhes pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung sgrib gsum bag chags dang bcas pa dz+wa la raṃ sarba pā paṃ shān+tiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes bris pa dril te bcug la bzhag pa rnams kha rang la phyogs par bya'o// de nas rten de rnams bsangs sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las/ pad+ma dkar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i steng du nṛ dang*/ tshe 'das skya bo yin na dngos ming*/ ban+de'i chos ming*/ sngags pa'i gsang mtshan dgos pas/ ming yig dang po thig les brgyan pa yongs su gyur pa las tshe 'das che ge mo'i phung khams skye mched 'byung ba yongs su tshang zhing gos rgyan rnam par brgyan pa gson pa'i dus ltar skad cig la gsal bar gyur par bsam/

rdor dril dang bcas/ ngag tu/ kye hoḥ nyon cig tshe 'das che ge mo// 'tsho bar byed pa'i tshe zad cing*// lnga phung sgyu ma'i grong khyer zhig /pha rol gnas su song ba khyod// rigs drug 'jig rten gar skyes kyang*// 'khor ba'i gnas na bde ba med// khyad par ngan song gsum gyi gnas// srid pa'i sdug bsngal bsam mi khyab// de bas rigs kyi bu nyon cig /'khor ba'i gnas la ma chags shing*// ma rungs log par 'dren pa yi// bslu brid tshig la ma nyan par// yi dam brtan pa'i sems kyis ni// deng gi gnas mchog dam pa 'dir| lha dang slob dpon spyan snga ru/ skad cig yud kyis 'dir shog cig /ces dang*/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgya'i rgyas/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ chos kyi bka' bden pa dang*/ dge 'dun gyi bka' bden pa dang*/ gsang sngags dang*/ rig sngags dang*/ gzungs sngags dang*/ snying po dang*/ phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi bden pa dang*/ bla ma yi dam mkha' 'gro rgyal ba zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i lha tshogs 'khor dang bcas pa'i bden pa dang*/ dam pa ye shes chos skyong ba'i srung ma mthu rtsal can rnams kyi/ bden pa chen po 'di'i mthus/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bya ba sa 'og /sa steng*/ sa bla/ bar do/ rigs drug gi lam lnga gang du gnas shing gar yod kyang da lta nyid du 'dir mchis par gyur cig /nṛ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dza dzaḥ zhes lan gsum dang*/ slar yang*/ oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha dzaḥ badz+ra pā sha hūm̐/ badz+ra s+pho ṭa baṃ/ badz+raghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ zhes rten la dgug gzhug cing dbab/ gshed dang phral ba ni/ rten gyi mdun du/ gtor ma ting lo chang bu gsum gsum bsham/ chus sbyangs/ oṃ a kā ro gsum gyis byin gyis brlabs/ gtor ma re re nas g.yas su bskor zhing*/ sarba bigh+nāṃ na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bh+yo bi shwa sogs/ ting lo dang chang bu g.yon du bskor zhing*/ oṃ suṃ bha ni sogs/ na mo/ sangs rgyas kyi bden pa/

zhes pa nas/ bden pa chen po'i mthus/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo zhes bgyi ba gson gyi dus su tshe gnas pa la bar du gcod cing*/ gshin gyi dus su sdig sgrib sbyong ba la bar du gcod par byed pa'i 'byung po bgegs rigs thams cad gtor ma 'dis lam rgyag /chang bu 'dis lam zan/ ting lo 'dis lam sgron gyis la dpag tshad rgyang grags su ma nye bar phyir dengs shig /gal te mi 'gro zhing 'dug par gyur na/ bdag nyid khro rgyal 'bar ba rab tu khros pa'i mtshon cha/ khro bo rdo rje dang ye shes kyi mes bsregs shing brlag par gdon mi za'o// zhes dang*/ suṃ bha nis sngags bsgrags/ rdo rje gsor/ yungs kar gyis brab/ gu gul bdug go// de nas/ oṃ badz+ra rak+ṣa rak+ṣa hūm̐ bh+rūṃ/ zhes rdo rje dang bcas pas/ tshe 'das kyi spyi bor reg pas rdo rje'i go cha dang ldan pas slar bgegs kyis mi tshugs par bsam/ de nas bye ma la dkyil 'khor pa'i sngags dang brab sngags bzlas pas rten la brab cing*/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ da ha na badz+ra ye hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba pā paṃ sho dha ni badz+ra hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ sarba karma ā wa ra ṇa bhasmiṃ ku ru hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bruṃ bi nā sha ā wa= oṃ truṃ bi sho dhā ya ā wa= oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la da ka da ka ha na ha na ā wa= oṃ sruṃ sa ra sa ra pra sa ra pra sa ra ā wa= oṃ hūm̐ ha ra ha ra sarba ā wa= oṃ hūm̐ phaṭa sarba ā wa ra ṇa bi s+pho ṭa ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ bri ta bri ta traṭa traṭa tshin+dha tshin+dha sarba ā wa= oṃ da ha da ha sarba na rak+ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ pa tsa pa tsa sarba pre ta ka ge he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ ma tha ma tha sarba tir+ya ka ga te he tuṃ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brab/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag par gyur cig |ces brjod/ rnam rgyal gyi chu las bum du cung zad blugs pas rgyal ba'i sku gsung thugs kyi rten me long du shar ba bkru zhing*/

ji ltar bltams pa tsam gyis ni// sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī ye hūm̐/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// sogs/ oṃ sarba ta thā= /de bzhin gshegs pa= /rin chen bum pa= /yid 'ong legs par bkang ba'i glu dang ni// rol mor bcas pa du mas sku khrus gsol| |oṃ sarba ta thā= ras dkar gyis phyi zhing*/ de dag sku la mtshungs pa med pa'i gos// gtsang la dri rab bgos pas sku phyi'o// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta kā ya bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes phyi/ slar khrus chu de nyid khrus bum du blugs par ro dang rus pa yin na dngos su dang*/ mtshan byang yin na me long du shar bas bkru zhing*/ 'di ni khrus mchog dpal dang ldan// sogs= dngos grub stsol bar mdzod/ */yon tan rgya mtsho dpag med pa'i// ting 'dzin sngags ldan khrus kyi chus// ye shes chu zla'i dkyil 'khor na// rnam shes pad+mo 'di bkrus pas// mu tig dkar po dri med ltar// dag par ma gyur gang yang med// tshe 'das lus ngag yid gsum gyi// dri ma ma lus dag gyur cig /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ 'di ni sbyin pa'i rang bzhin chu// ser sna'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtong ba dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ 'di ni tshul khrims rang bzhin chu// 'chal ba'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// gtsang ma dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/

'di ni bzod pa'i rang bzhin chu// khong khro'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// byams pa dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ 'di ni brtson 'grus rang bzhin chu// le lo'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// nan tan dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ 'di ni bsam gtan rang bzhin chu// rnam g.yeng dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// ting 'dzin dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ 'di ni shes rab rang bzhin chu// rmongs pa'i dri ma sbyong mdzad cing*// mkhyen pa dri yis legs bgos chus// khrus legs mdzad cing khrus bgyi'o// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ zhes dang*/ tshe las 'das pa che ge mo'i lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgo nas ser sna la sogs pa'i dbang gis bgyis pa'i sdig sgrib nyes ltung thams cad byang zhing dag nas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la sogs pa'i drug yongs su rdzogs nas mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar gyur cig /ces brjod/ dug gsum sbyong ba ni/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// sangs rgyas dkon mchog dug mi mnga'// sangs rgyas bden pas dug bcom mo// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ

oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// dam chos dkon mchog dug mi mnga'// dam chos bden pas dug bcom mo// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// dge 'dun dkon mchog dug mi mnga'// dge 'dun bden pas dug bcom mo// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ 'dod chags zhe sdang gti mug gsum// 'di dag 'jig rten dug gsum ste// rgyal ba zhi khro dug mi mnga'// rgyal ba'i bden pas dug bcom mo// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ de bzhin du/ sa ni dug gi pha yin te// sa ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum sa yi nang du song*// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ chu ni dug gi pha yin te// chu ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum chu yi nang du song*// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ me ni dug gi pha yin te// me ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum me yi nang du song*// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ

oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ rlung ni dug gi pha yin te// rlung ni dug gi ma yang yin// bden pa'i bden tshig 'di dag gis// dug gsum rlung gi nang du song*// oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu āḥ oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ phaṭa/ sarba pā paṃ ā wa ra ṇa bi sho dha na ye swā hā/ tshe 'das che ge mo'i nyon mongs pa dug gsum thams cad dkon mchog rin po che rnam pa gsum dang*/ rgyal ba zhi khro dam pa rigs brgya'i bka' bden pas 'byung ba'i bag la zhi bar gyur cig /'byung ba'i ngang du thim par gyur cig /ces brjod/ shis par bya ba ni/ rten la me tog 'thor zhing*/ stong zhing bdag 'dzin bral ba'i chos// zhes pa nas/ dam tshig rdo rje spun gyi bkra shis shog /ces pa'i bar las byang dkyus ltar brjod/ de nas tshe 'das kyi nye drung ngam grogs yid mthun gyis rus bu dang byang bu yin na lag tu thogs la phyag 'tshal nas tshe 'das kyis kyang phyag 'tshal bar bsams la/ rgyas par byed na/ hūm̐ */ chos dbyings ngang nas rang byung dbyer med pa'i// zhes pa nas/ bla med mchog gi dngos grub bstsal du gsol// zhes pa'i bar las byang dkyus ltar gyi bstod pa ltar la phyag 'tshal bstod ces par phyag 'tshal lo zhes par bsgyur la phyag 'tshal lo// yang long skabs dang bstun phyag 'tshal bsdus par byed na/ rgyal ba rigs lnga khrag 'thung yab yum dang*// sems dpa'i sems ma thub drug sgo ba bzhi// kau ri singha sgo ma dbang phyug bzhi// ma dang mkha' 'gro chos skyong gter bdag dang*// laṅka brgyad dang ma bdun sring mo bzhi// ging chen bco brgyad pho nya drug cu dang*// brtan ma bcu gnyis 'jig rten skyong ba'i lha// sprul pa yang sprul tshogs la phyag 'tshal lo// zhes phyag 'tshal du bcug /de nas dbang bskur ba ni/ slob ma'i bya ba thams cad tshe 'das kyis byas par bsams la/

khrus bya maṇ+ḍal dbul/ kyai/ rdo rje slob dpon gsan 'tshal lo// kun bzang zhi khro rigs lnga yi// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs spangs nas ni// gzhan du bsgrub bya ma mchis pas// khyod kyis skyabs mdzod lha dang sprod// dbang bskur dam pa bstsal du gsol// lan gsum gsol ba btab/ bla mas/ kye ma skal ldan rigs kyi bu// ye shes chen po'i dkyil 'khor du// ma bskyed bzhi ldan lha tshogs bzhugs// sems kyi sgo phyes rig mdangs thon// dkyil 'khor lha tshogs rnams la ltos// zhes brjod/ rdo rje mgor bzhag la/ kye ma rigs kyi bu mchog khyod// zhi khro rigs brgya'i dkyil 'khor du// zhugs zhing dbang bskur bdag gis sbyin// tshul 'di snod min la smras na// khyod kyi mgo snying bkas te nyams// zhes gsang bar gdams/ dam chu sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni dam tshig rdo rje'i chu| |khyod la sbyin zhing dam bsrung na// dngos grub rnam gnyis 'bad med 'grub// nyams na las kyi gshin rje ni// lcags sdig mgo dgur sprul nas kyang*// khyod kyi snying khrag hub kyis 'debs// rdo rje'i dmyal bar ltung 'gyur gyi// de bas mna' yi btung bar rol// pañtsa a mṛ ta u da ka ṭhaḥ zhes sbyin/ slob mas/ sa ma ya i dan+te na rak+kan/ zhes mna' bor mna' chu btung*/ skyabs su 'gro ba ni/ na mo/ lta ba bla med chos sku phyogs lhung bral// sgom pa bla med longs sku dmigs gtad bral// spyod pa bla med sprul sku blang dor bral// 'bras bu bla med re dogs spang blang bral// bdag sogs 'gro drug sems can skyabs su mchi// lan gsum/ sems bskyed pa ni/ ji ltar sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams// gsang sngags lam zhugs 'gro ba kun// sman par mdzad pa de yi ni// rjes zhugs bdag kyang de ltar bgyi// lan gsum/ sdom bzung ni/ bdag gis deng nas byang chub bar// dkon mchog gsum bzung mi spang ngo*// sku gsum dam tshig sdom pa gzung*// lta sgom spyod dang gzhi lam 'bras// rigs lnga spyi dang bye brag gi// sdom pa deng nas bdag gis gzung*// khrel yod ngo tsha bag ldan zhing*// srog gcod tshig rtsub ngan sems spang*// lus ngag yid gsum dge la bkol// sems can don kun bsgrub par bgyi'o// zhes khas blangs/

auṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes slob ma'i gnas gsum du rdo rjes reg /ye shes dbab pa ni/ slob ma skad cig gis kun tu bzang po mthing nag gcer bu phyag gnyis mnyam bzhag rdo rje skyil mo krung du bzhugs pa'i klad pa dung khang du khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad/ snying khar zhi ba bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis gsal ba'i rnam par snang mdzad kyi thugs ka'i 'od kyis phyogs bcu dus gsum sangs rgyas thams cad kyi sku gsung thugs kyi bcud bsdus pa gser gyi 'khor lo rtsibs stong dang ldan pa'i rnam par gyur pa rab tu 'khor bas lus ngag yid gsum rdo rje gsum gyi rang bzhin du gyur par mos la rol mo sgrog cing*/ oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta= dz+nyā na ā we sha ya a a aḥ zhes brjod/ tiṣ+ṭha badz+ra dang*/ rdo rje rgya gram gyis brtan par bya/ slob mas/ oṃ gu ru de wa ḍā ki nī shan+ta kro dha maṇ+ḍal puṣ+pe pū dza pra tīts+tsha ye hūm̐/ zhes me tog dor/ bla mas me tog de nyid slob ma'i mgor bcing*/ oṃ gu ru kro dha ma hā satwa a nu dha ra dza yan+tu/ zhes brjod/ dbang bskur dngos la zhi ba'i dbang ni/ rnam rgyal bum pa thogs la/ hūm̐ */ bum pa sprol bral chos kyi dbyings// mgul chings lnga ldan longs spyod rdzogs// gzung thag pad phreng sprul pa'i sku// nang na zhi ba zhe gnyis bzhugs// skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas// rang snang rang rig rtogs par shog /oṃ bo dhi tsit+ta ma hā su kha dz+nyā na dhā tu a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes dbang bskur bum chu khar sbyin/ bskur tshig dang bcas pa'i tsakli'i dbang bskur zhing*/ hūm̐ */ kun bzang rnam snang rdo rje sems// rin chen 'byung ldan 'od dpag med// don grub bcas pa'i dbang bskur bas// rgyal ba'i sku ru smin gyur cig /oṃ sa man+ta bha dra pañtsa dza ya a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ kun tu bzang mo dbyings phyug ma// mā ma kī dang sangs rgyas spyan// na bza' dkar mo sgrol mar bcas// yum mchog rnams kyi dbang bskur sbyin// oṃ sa man+ta bha dri pañtsa mā trī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

hūm̐ */ sa yi snying po nam mkha'i snying*// spyan ras gzigs dang rdo rje 'dzin// byams pa sgrib pa rnam par sel// kun tu bzang po 'jam dpal dbyangs// sems dpa' brgyad kyi dbang bskur sbyin// oṃ aṣ+ṭa bo dhi satwa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ lā s+ya mā le gī ti ma// nṛ t+yai puṣ+pe dhū pe dang*// dī pe gan+dhe ma rnams te| |sems ma brgyad kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ aṣ+ṭa satwa nī a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ lha dang lha min mi rnams dang*// byol song yi dwags dmyal ba yi// gnas ngan sbyong mdzad sprul pa'i sku// thub pa drug gi dbang bskur sbyin// oṃ ṣaṭa mu ni a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ lcags kyu zhags pa lcags sgrog dril// byams dang snying rje dga' ba dang*// btang snyoms tshad med ngo bo nyid// sgo ba yab yum dbang bskur ro// oṃ tsa turmu kha rak+ṣa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la zhi ba'i lha tshogs bzhi bcu rtsa gnyis kyi dbang bskur bas/ phung po lnga sangs rgyas rigs lnga| khams lnga yab yum lnga/ skye mched bcu drug sems dpa' sems ma bcu drug /dug lnga ser sna dang bcas pa thub pa drug /dbang po'i sgo bzhi sgo ba yab yum brgyad du rang grol rtog tshogs thams cad zhi ba bzhi bcu zhe gnyis su rang dag /lus lha/ ngag sngags/ sems 'od gsal bde ba chen por rang grol bar byas so// khro bo'i dbang ni/ thod pa thogs la/ hūm̐ */ bhan+dha 'bar ba'i gzhal yas khang*// dregs pa bsnol steng me dpung nang*// khrag 'thung lnga bcu rtsa brgyad po// skal ldan bu la dbang bskur bas// kun gzhi'i bag chags sel bar shog /oṃ ru lu ru lu hūm̐ bh+yo hūm̐ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes thod pa mgo bor bzhag bdud rtsi sbyin/ sku'i dbang ni/ hūm̐ */ de bzhin rigs dang rdo rje'i rigs// rin chen pad+ma las kyi rigs// khro bo chen po lnga yi dbang*// bskur bas dug lnga rnam dag shog

/oṃ pañtsa ma hā kro dha a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hū?m̐ */ kau rī ma dang tsau rī ma// pra mo ha dang be tā lī// puk+ka sī dang gasma rī// tsaṇ+ḍa lī dang sme sha ni// tshogs brgyad dag phyir dbang bskur ro// hūm̐ aṣ+ṭa ma mo a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ singha byā gh+rī sri la ma// shwa na kṛ ta kaṃ ka ma// khwa khwa ul+lu mu khar bcas// rtsal snang dbyings su dag bya'i phyir// phra men brgyad kyi dbang bskur ro// oṃ aṣ+ṭa mu khaṃ a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ lcags kyus 'gugs shing zhags pas sdom// lcags sgrog gis 'ching dril bus 'bebs// rta phag seng sbrul mgo bo can| |sgo ma bzhi yi dbang bskur ro// oṃ badz+ra aṃ ku sha s+pho ṭa pā sha ghaṇ+ṭe hoḥ hūm̐ */ srin mo tshangs pa lha chen dang*// rtog 'dod dga' ba zhi ba la// rdo rje khyung bcas zhi ba'i lha// shar gyi ma bdun dbang bskur ro// bh+yo a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ zla ba be con srin mo dang*// za ba 'gro ba stobs chen mo// rdo rje dang bcas rgyas pa'i lha// lho yi ma bdun dbang bskur ro// hūm̐ bh+yo a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐| hūm̐ */ srin mo 'dod pa nor srung dang*// rlung lha mi mo phag mo dang*// pad+mar bcas pa dbang gi lha// nub kyi ma bdun dbang bskur ro// hūm̐ bh+yo a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ hūm̐ */ rdo rje sna chen chu lha dang*| |rdo rje nor srung srin mo khyung*// rdo rje dang bcas drag po'i dbang*// byang gi ma bdun dbang bskur ro// hūm̐ bh+yo a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la khro bo khrag 'thung gi lha tshogs lnga bcu rtsa brgyad kyi dbang bskur bas/ nyon mongs 'du byed la sogs pa gnas bsgyur nas ye shes khro bo chen po'i rang bzhin du dag par byas pa yin no// mtha' rten bkra shis rtags brgyad kyi dbang ni/ hūm̐ */ sngon gyi rgyal ba rnams la ni// bkra shis rtags kyis mnga' gsol ltar// deng 'dir skal ldan bu khyod la// dbu la gdugs dang spyan gser nya// ljags la pad+ma tshems dung dkar| |mgul la bum pa thugs dpal be'u// sku la rgyal mtshan zhabs 'khor lo// bkra shis dag pas mnga' gsol bas// rnam pa kun tu bkra shis pa'i// dpal la spyod pa'i dbang thob shog

|oṃ aṣ+ṭa maṅga la a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ de ltar skal ldan rigs kyi bu khyod la bkra shis rtags brgyad kyis mnga' gsol zhing dbang bskur bas/ rnam pa thams cad du mi mthun pa'i phyogs las rnam par rgyal nas bkra shis bde legs phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal dang ldan par byas pa yin no// zhes brjod/ gtso bos ji ltar bka' bstsal pa// sogs dang*/ gtang rag gi maṇ+ḍal 'bul/ de nas zas gtad bya ba ni/ rten gyi drung du bza' bca' btung ba'i tshogs ci 'byor ba bshams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis dpag tu med par spel zhing*/ oṃ a kā ro sogs gsum gyis bsngos/ hūm̐ */ tshe 'das lus brjes rigs kyi bu khyod nyon// byams gdung yid la bcag pa'i gnyen 'dun dang*// smon lam las 'brel mthun pa'i grogs rnams dang*// yun du 'grogs pa'i dbang dang skal med kyang*// brtse ba'i sems kyis longs spyod sna tshogs bsags// thugs rje thabs dang ldan pa'i slob dpon gyis// longs spyod gter chen 'phrul gyi nor rdzas dang*// ro mchog bcud dang ldan pa'i zhal zas dang*| |nyon mongs gdung ba sel ba'i btung ba bshams// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te// tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis// bkres skom sdug bsngal ma lus zhi nas ni// yun gyi zas dang skom du 'byung bar shog /'dod yon longs spyod 'di ltar dpag med kyang*// gzugs sgra dri ro reg bya la sogs rdzas// dngos su 'byor dang yid kyis legs sprul nas// ting 'dzin sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs te// tshe 'das rigs kyi bu la bsngos pa yis// 'dod yon longs spyod dpal du spyod par shog /ces bsngo zhing mer bsreg /lhag ma ngan sprang la sbyin/ de nas zhing gi lam bstan pa ni/ e ma/ nyon cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// dmyal ba'i tsha grang sran mi bzod// yi dwags bkres skom rab tu phongs// dud 'gro blun rmongs mun pa 'dra// mi yi skye ba mi rtag 'gyur// lha min 'thab rtsod me ltar 'bar// lha yi g.yeng bas chos dang bral// rigs drug gnas na bde ba med// 'khor ba rang bzhin sdug bsngal bas// de bas 'khor bar ma chags par/

'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// bde ba can gyi zhing khams yod// chos dbyings rnam dag gzhal yas khang*// chos sku rtog bral nam mkha' 'dra// longs sku ye shes 'ja' tshon 'dra// sprul sku yid bzhin nor bu 'dra// bcom ldan chos rje 'od dpag med// byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor gyis bskor// srid par sbyor ba yongs su zad// rnam grol bde ba'i dngos grub brnyes// zhing gi yon tan bsam mi khyab// bu khyod de ru lam bstan gyi// 'od dpag med pa'i mtshan bzung ba// zhing mchog de ru 'gro bar gyis// oṃ a mi de wa hrīḥpad+ma dha ri hūm̐/ zhes brjod/ de nas dkyil 'khor dang rten gyi bar du mar me gsal po zhig sbar ba bzhag ste/ e ma/ gal te mi shes rmongs pa yis// 'jig rten smag rum 'thom pas na// ma rig mun sel sgron me 'dis// ye shes snang ba thob gyur cig /oṃ badz+ra ā lo ke hrīḥ zhes brjod ma thag bde ba can gyi zhing khams su mgon po 'od dpag tu med pa byang chub sems dpa'i 'khor rnams la chos ston pa tshe 'das kyis mngon sum mthong bar gyur par bsams la/ hrīḥ 'phags mchog rgyal po thugs rje'i 'od zer dang*// tshe 'das dad pa'i shugs kyi rgyud sbrel nas// skad cig tsam la gnyis med gcig gyur te// bde chen gnas su myur du bsgrod par shog /oṃ dz+nyā na sa ma ya satwa āḥhrīḥphaṭa/ ces brjod ma thag mgon po 'od dpag med kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar po glog 'gyu ba ltar byung bas/ rten la gnas pa'i tshe 'das kyi rnam shes la phog ma thag a yig dkar por gyur pa rdo khab len gyis lcags blang ba ltar rtsen gyis blangs nas 'od dpag med kyi thugs kar thim par gyur cig par bsam/ slar yang*/ e ma/ dkon mchog rin chen dpal zhing du// dkon mchog rin chen las byung ba'i// dkon mchog rin chen 'od zer gyi// rin chen phreng ba rnam dag pa// tshogs kyi lam dang sbyor ba'i lam// mthong ba'i lam dang bsgom pa'i lam// bla na med pa'i khyad par lam// byang chub bar chad med pa'i lam| |rnam par grol ba'i lam dag la// brten nas sdig pa kun byang ste// 'phags pa'i lam der bsgrod par shog

/dkon mchog gsum gyi thugs rje dang*// gsang sngags bsgrubs pa'i bden pa dang*// sngags 'chang rgyal ba'i byin rlabs kyis// zhing mchog der ni skye bar shog /oṃ rat+ne rat+ne ma hā rat+ne/ rat+na saṃ bha wa rat+na ki rat+ne/ rat+na mā la bi shud+dhe sho dhā ya/ sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ phaṭa| ces lam bstan/ smon lam gdab pa ni/ hrīḥ pad+ma 'dam gyis ma gos ltar// srid gsum dri mas ma gos shing*// srid pa'i pad+mo las byung ba'i// bde ba can du skye bar shog /ces brjod/ mar gyi rū pa'i nang gi ming byang ras dkar gyi sdong bur dril/ mar gyi gzugs bzhu bas snang gsal byas la dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar bzhag /slar byang bu lag tu thogs la rnam dag zhing gi smon lam gdab pa ni/ e ma/ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na/ */bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// sems can srog ni sa yin te// sa la shi zhes bya ba med// de bzhin rigs kyi bu khyod kyang*// sangs rgyas spyan dang gnyis su med// bde'o skyid do rnam dag zhing*// zhing mchog der ni skye bar shog /e ma/ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// sems can srog ni chu yin te// chu la shi zhes bya ba med// de bzhin rigs kyi bu khyod kyang*// mā ma kī dang gnyis su med// bde'o skyid do rnam dag zhing*// zhing mchog der ni skye bar shog /e ma/ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// sems can srog ni me yin te// me la shi zhes bya ba med// de bzhin rigs kyi bu khyod kyang*// gos dkar mo dang gnyis su med// bde'o skyid do rnam dag zhing*// zhing mchog der ni skye bar shog /e ma/ 'di nas nub kyi phyogs rol na// bde ba can gyi zhing khams na// sems can srog ni rlung yin te// rlung la shi zhes bya ba med| |de bzhin rigs kyi bu khyod kyang*// dam tshig sgrol dang gnyis su med// bde'o skyid do rnam dag zhing*// zhing mchog der ni skye bar shog

/ces dang*/ gzhan yang smon lam gang 'thad gdab/ byang bu de nyid dkyil 'khor gyi lte bar mar me la bsregs shing*/ gson cig dgongs shig rigs kyi bu// gson cig tshe 'das rigs kyi bu// phung po lnga yi bud shing la// rgyal ba rigs lnga'i me sbar ro// 'byung ba bzhi yi bud shing la// lha mo bzhi yi me sbar ro// nyon mongs lnga yi bud shing la// ye shes lnga yi me sbar ro// dbang po drug gi bud shing la// byang chub sems kyi me sbar ro// yul snang drug gi bud shing la// lha mo drug gi me sbar ro// lus ngag yid gsum bud shing la// rgyal ba'i sku gsum me sbar ro// sku gsum ye shes lnga ldan pa// 'gro ba'i don du 'grub par shog /ces bsregs pa'i ro ma dang mar me'i sdong ro la sāts+tsha gdab/ ro yin na zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gis sbyang*/ de rjes lhag mchod gtong ba nas bzung bsdu chog gi bar las byang dkyus ltar bya zhing*/ bsngo smon/ shis brjod sogs byin chags par byas la las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya/ smras pa/ kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi// las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba yi// lhan thabs dus mtha'i cho ga 'di// 'gro la sman slad sbyar ba yi// dge tshogs rab dkar gang mchis pa// sems can kun don bsgrub pa'i phyir// bsngo yi bdag 'dod ga la mchis// de ltar kun bzang dgongs pa kun 'dus kyi zhi khro gsang ba 'dus pa'i las byang pad+ma'i phreng ba'i lhan thabs gshin po rjes 'dzin gyi cho ga thar pa'i lam bzang zhes bya ba 'di'ang*/ 'on 'od gsal lding gi gdan sa nas kun spangs bla ma len pa bas bskul ngor/ dbur stod 'bri gung gi byang phyogs kyi rgyud du byung ba/ skyu ra'i rigs las shākya'i dge slong rig sngags 'chang ba/ chos kyi grags pas gser 'phyang gi lo tha skar can gyi dmar po'i rdzogs pa dang po'i dus dge bar/ 'bri klung rtse ba gzhis ka sra brtan rdo rje'i gnas mchog tu sbyar ba 'dis kyang lnga par thal ba'i skye 'gro thams cad la mchog tu phan par gyur cig/
